decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period expiring 3 years from the date of implementation when the use shall cease.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith and numbered, unnumbered floor plan, received 13/08/2010 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - 4.	The site shall be used as a Further Education with ancillary offices use (part D1 and part B1 use) and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
description: Continued use of Suites 7 and 20 for D1 (educational) use for a period of 5 years.
